text:
Alex (marketing): Quick sync — planning the public announcement for Adaptive Batching v1. Target publish: Wed 10:00 PT. Need: final changelog snippet, canonical docs URL, webinar promo copy, and inbound lead routing tags. Who can confirm timing windows?
Maya (eng): 10:00 PT is OK from eng side if we freeze the canary by 06:00 PT. Can push canary at 06:15 and start monitoring.
Alex (marketing): Cool. @Maya can you paste the one-paragraph changelog we can use in the blog & release notes? Keep it end-user friendly.
Maya (eng): Dropping a short changelog now — feel free to edit for tone:
```
- Introduced workload-aware adaptive batching: reduces per-token latency by 25% on small requests while preserving tail latency.
- Added prefix caching for repeated context across sessions.
- Safety: stricter token filters in the serving layer to reduce hallucination surface.
```
Priya (docs): Linking the canonical docs here: https://docs.redwood.ai/feature/adaptive-batching-v1 — I'll add a "For developers" section and a small migration snippet by EOD.
Jamal (product): Webinar: we have a 30-min slot Friday 11:00 PT for a product walkthrough + live Q&A. Marketing to confirm RSVP CTA and a short demo script.
Alex (marketing): For inbound routing: we want leads tagged as "feature_adaptive_batching" + "webinar_followup" in the CRM. @Nikhil can you confirm the tracking params and hub mapping?
Nikhil (growth): Will set UTM params and the CRM tag. Proposed UTM: utm_campaign=adaptive-batching-v1&utm_medium=launch&utm_source=blog. I'll chat with SDRs to route webinar registrants to a nurture track.
Alex (marketing): Excellent. Two ops asks for engineering: 1) Can we set a temporary fallback model in routing if the canary breaches latency SLO? 2) Any sensitive wording in changelog we should avoid for legal/compliance?
Maya (eng): 1) Yes — we'll enable fallback to the compatible quantized variant automatically if 95th percentile > 300ms for 5m. 2) Nothing flagged by us; legal might review the safety line.
Priya (docs): I'll prepare the snippet and add a short migration code example:
```
# migration example
client.generate(model="adaptive-batching-v1", inputs=payload, batching=True)
```
Alex (marketing): Ping me when legal signs off on the safety sentence. Also want a short "what this means for customers" 1-2 bullets for the blog.
Jamal (product): Draft bullets: 1) lower per-request cost for chatty apps, 2) fewer cold-start delays for short prompts.
Alex (marketing): Perfect. @deploy-bot schedule?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled — start=2026-03-25T06:15:00Z, monitor window 30m, fallback variant enabled. :rocket:
Maya (eng): We'll keep on-call staffed for the first 2 hours after 10:00 PT. I'll post a short runbook in #eng-oncall before the canary.
Alex (marketing): Thanks everyone — I'll prep the blog + social copy and share the draft in this thread for final greenlight by 04:30 PT. :thumbsup:
